original.statement: The Cilium Operator's six CiliumEndpointSlice rate limit flags (ces-write-qps-limit, ces-write-qps-burst, ces-enable-dynamic-rate-limit, ces-dynamic-rate-limit-nodes, ces-dynamic-rate-limit-qps-limit, ces-dynamic-rate-limit-qps-burst) are deprecated and their usage is now ignored; the ces-rate-limits flag or ciliumEndpointSlice.rateLimits Helm value replaces them.

corrected.statement: In Cilium 1.16 the cilium-operator flag --ces-write-qps-limit is deprecated and its value is ignored. The CiliumEndpointSlice controller now uses dynamic rate limiting based on cluster size, and custom configuration is supplied via --ces-rate-limits (or Helm ciliumEndpointSlice.rateLimits).

decision.reason: [ev-7994b2163342] says the cilium-operator flag `ces-write-qps-limit` has "been deprecated and their usage will be ignored", and that `ces-rate-limits` (or the Helm value `ciliumEndpointSlice.rateLimits`) now supplies custom rate-limit configuration. The subject is right. A flag that is ignored no longer works, so this is a "removed" change (no longer honoured) with replacedBy --ces-rate-limits, not "deprecated", which in this vocabulary means it still works.
